author: West Central Reporter
title: Western Illinois women's basketball to open new year against UT Martin
text:
Western Hall | Western Illinois University Leathernecks
Western Hall | Western Illinois University Leathernecks
Western Illinois University’s women’s basketball team will begin 2026 with a matchup against the UT Martin Skyhawks on January 1. The game is scheduled for a 1 p.m. CT tip-off at the Elam Center in Martin, Tennessee.
The Leathernecks currently hold a 10-1 overall record and are undefeated in Ohio Valley Conference (OVC) play at 2-0. Their most recent game saw them defeat SIUE by a score of 75–51 at Western Hall. In that contest, Mia Nicastro recorded a double-double with 19 points and 11 rebounds. Mallory Shetley contributed 13 points, while Allie Meadows added 10 points. Western Illinois controlled the paint and capitalized on turnovers, converting 21 SIUE turnovers into 24 points and shooting efficiently from the free-throw line.
The upcoming opponent, UT Martin, enters the game with a record of 5-6 overall and an OVC mark of 1-1. The Skyhawks are led by head coach Kevin McMillan and feature veteran guard Kenley McCarn as their leading scorer and playmaker. Forward Zy Thompson provides strong rebounding, while other key contributors include Norah Clark along with newcomers Brittani Wells, Sidney Blackwell, and Sidni Middleton. The Skyhawks have demonstrated balanced scoring and competitive defense so far this season.
The last meeting between these teams was on March 5, when Western Illinois won by a score of 78-72.
After facing UT Martin, Western Illinois will continue its road trip against SEMO Redhawks on January 3 at 1 p.m. CT. Additional information about the schedule can be found at https://goleathernecks.com/sports/womens-basketball/schedule.
Fans can follow updates on Leatherneck Women’s Basketball through GoLeathernecks.com or via social media platforms including X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, and Facebook.
